article_what_money_is.summary: Money is an agreement, not a thing with value in itself. After reading this you can name the three jobs money does, say what a bank balance and a banknote really are, separate a stock of money from a flow of income, find the costs that never reach the invoice, and tell a nominal figure from a real one.
article_what_money_is.title: What Money Is: A Promise, a Tool and a Record
